segments.text: For example, grinding machine, drilling machine, wood cutter machine, welding machine etc.

segments.text: So let's see what are the thousands of power tools.

segments.text: Power tools are used and it is called power i.e. electrical power supply.
segments.zh: 使用电动工具，之所以叫“电动”，是因为它用的是电源供电。

segments.text: So the important thing is that the thousands of power tools are called electrical shock.
segments.zh: 所以重要的一点是，电动工具的危害就是所谓的触电。

segments.text: So the first thousand is electrical shock.
segments.zh: 所以第一种危害是触电。

segments.text: The fourth is cut injuries.
segments.zh: 第四种是割伤。

segments.text: When you are using power tools, you have more chances of getting cut injuries.
segments.zh: 在使用电动工具时，你被割伤的可能性更大。

segments.text: The fifth is burn injuries.
segments.zh: 第五种是烧伤。

segments.text: When you are using a grinding machine and any spark falls on you, it is more dangerous to burn your body.
segments.zh: 当你使用磨光机时，如果有火花落到你身上，烧伤身体的危险就更大。

segments.text: The sixth is noise.
segments.zh: 第六种是噪声。

segments.text: Whenever you use power tools, the noise level is also high.
segments.zh: 每当你使用电动工具时，噪声水平也很高。

segments.text: And the seventh is vibrations.

segments.text: So let's see what are the precautions of power tools.
segments.zh: 那我们来看看电动工具有哪些预防措施。

segments.text: First of all, whenever you are using power tools, you have to make sure that its power supply is 110 volts.
segments.zh: 首先，每当你使用电动工具时，必须确保它的电源是 110 伏。

segments.text: And for whatever power supply is being supplied to it, it is equipped with an ELC of 30 milliampere.
segments.zh: 而且给它供电的任何电源，都要配备 30 毫安的 ELCB。

segments.text: Whatever power tools you are using, it is necessary to have a dead man switch.
segments.zh: 不管你使用什么电动工具，都必须有失能开关。

segments.text: The third is the guard of that machine.
segments.zh: 第三是机器的防护罩。

segments.text: The fourth is that no combustible material should be used in the area where you want to use power tools.
segments.zh: 第四是在你要使用电动工具的区域内，不应使用任何可燃材料。

segments.text: Or no flammable material should be used.
segments.zh: 或者不应使用任何易燃材料。

segments.text: If you are using a grinding machine and you have a wheel, that is the rpm of the disk.
segments.zh: 如果你使用的是磨光机，而你有一个砂轮，也就是磨片的转速。

segments.text: That means the rotation per minute should be bigger than the rpm of the machine.
segments.zh: 也就是说，它的每分钟转数应该大于机器的转速。

segments.text: That is, it should be more.
segments.zh: 也就是说，它应该更高。

segments.text: Whatever power tools you are using, it should be a spark containment.
segments.zh: 不管你使用什么电动工具，都应该有火花围挡。

segments.text: That is, whatever spark is being produced, you have to cover it so that the spark can go out.
segments.zh: 也就是说，不管产生什么火花，你都要把它遮挡起来，这样火花就可以出去。

segments.text: Whenever you use a welding machine and use a welding machine, you need to make a welding booth for whatever spark is produced.
segments.zh: 每当你使用电焊机，使用电焊机时，你需要为产生的火花搭建一个焊接棚。

segments.text: Whatever power tools you are using, there should be fire extinguishers.
segments.zh: 不管你使用什么电动工具，都应该配备灭火器。

segments.text: Also, there should be a fire blanket.
segments.zh: 此外，还应该有灭火毯。

segments.text: And there should be a fire watchman to handle them.
segments.zh: 还应该有一名防火监护人来处理这些。

segments.text: Whatever person is using power tools, it is necessary to apply double eye protection.
segments.zh: 使用电动工具的人，都必须采取双重眼部防护。

segments.text: For example, if he is grinding, then he has to apply safety goggles.
segments.zh: 比如，如果他在打磨，那么他必须戴上安全护目镜。

segments.text: And on top of that, he has to apply a facial mask.
segments.zh: 在此之上，还必须戴上面罩。

segments.text: Whenever you are using power tools, you have to wear leather gloves.
segments.zh: 每当你使用电动工具时，都要戴皮手套。

segments.text: You should have a fire resistant apron and you should wear it.
segments.zh: 你应该有一件阻燃围裙，并且要穿上它。

segments.text: If you are using power tools, if the noise level is too high, then there is a problem in listening.
segments.zh: 如果你在使用电动工具时噪声太大，就会影响听力。

segments.text: So at that time you have to use an air plug and an air muff.
segments.zh: 所以这时你要使用耳塞和耳罩。

segments.text: If you believe that the work is of long duration, it is more of time.
segments.zh: 如果你认为这项工作持续时间很长，耗时较多，

segments.zh: 这时，你就要对这个人持续进行岗位轮换。
